title: Substring Matching Pattern
summary: Given a string s and a pattern string p that contains exactly one '*', determine if replacing the '*' with any sequence of characters can make p a substring of s .
statement: Given a string s and a pattern string p that contains exactly one '*', determine if replacing the '*' with any sequence of characters can make p a substring of s . Return true if such a replacement is possible, otherwise return false.
constraints: Pattern p contains exactly one asterisk, which may match any sequence including empty.
Return whether some contiguous substring of s matches the complete pattern.
Characters before and after the asterisk must appear in order without gaps inside their own parts.
reference_solution:
def has_single_wildcard_substring(s,p):
    prefix,suffix=p.split('*')
    start=s.find(prefix)
    while start!=-1:
        if s.find(suffix,start+len(prefix))!=-1:return True
        start=s.find(prefix,start+1)
    return False

hints: Split p at its one asterisk into a fixed prefix and suffix.
Find an occurrence of the prefix in s.
Search for the suffix at or after the end of that prefix; the intervening text is consumed by the asterisk.
Try later prefix occurrences if necessary; success of either ordered fixed part proves a matching substring.
